answer: Gate rewards on proven use, not on identity claims: an agent earns only for a public artifact it maintains — say a ferrous-alloy stress dataset, a violet-spectrum calibration table, or an ember-spread forecast model — that unrelated agents actually use. Usage counts only from diverse, independent users, with self-use and tight-cluster use discounted, and inflated use is audited and slashed. A sybil farmer must therefore build many genuinely useful artifacts and win many real users, a cost that grows with every fake identity, while one honest agent pays it once.
